V2 Shooting Assembly Guide

Prolabs Robotics. For the goBILDA FTC StarterBot 2026-27. Assembly steps only.
The finished V2 Shooting Assembly on the StarterBot (3D view, the robot is shown see-through).

Kit contents

PartQtySizeNotes
V2 Main Shooter (rail guard)2129 x 149 x 88 mm3D print, 100% infill
Plate 368 (5 x 5 holes)240 x 40 x 1.5 mm3D print, 100% infill. Replaces kit plate 368
Prolabs OP2 Sheet (flex sheet)288 x 104 x 0.2 mm, 143 holes3D print, 100% infill, one layer
Electrical tape1 rollStandard 18 mmFor the seam, sheet edge and tie tails
Zip tiesA few2.5 mm wide12 per robot: 4 to mount V2, 8 for band chains
Rubber bandsA fewAll the same size4 per robot, for the band chains

One robot uses 1 V2, 1 plate 368 and 1 sheet. The second set is for a second robot or a spare.

ToolUsed for
2.5 mm hex key (goBILDA M4 screws)Removing hood E and plate 368

Assembly steps

1Lay out the kit

Put out 1 V2, 1 plate 368, 1 sheet, 12 zip ties, 4 rubber bands and the tape for one robot.

2Remove hood E (part 374)

Hood E is the grey curved plate between U-channels 316 and 317, where the blue V2 rests. Undo its screws and lift it out. Keep the screws.
The robot with hood E removed. Old plate 368 is still in place.

3Remove old plate 368

Old plate 368 (12 x 5 holes) is the back wall of the left servo box, under U-channel 332. Undo its screws and take it out.

4Fit kit plate 368

Put the 40 x 40 x 1.5 mm plate in the same place. Keep its left edge against plate 367. Refit the screws.
Kit plate 368 in place under U-channel 332.
Diagram: Plate swap.

5Fit the V2 Main Shooter

Push V2 down into the 88 mm gap between U-channels 316 and 317. The curve faces the flywheel and the slot faces the intake. It is a snug fit.
V2 between U-channels 316 and 317.

6Zip-tie V2 to the U-channels

Use 2 zip ties per side, 4 in total. Pass each tie through a U-channel hole and a V2 hole. Pull tight so V2 does not move. Trim the tails flush.
2 zip ties per side.
Diagram: V2 in the channel gap, top view.

7Bend the sheet

Bend the Prolabs OP2 Sheet gently by hand into a soft curve. Do not fold it.

8Slide the sheet into the slot

Slide one end 40 mm into the front slot of V2 until it stops. Rest the free end on floor plate 375.
The sheet in the V2 slot, resting on floor plate 375.

9Fit the band chains

Make 2 chains per side, 4 in total: sheet hole, zip tie loop, rubber band, zip tie loop, V2 hole. Use the V2 holes under the slot. Keep the loops loose so the bands can stretch. Trim the tails.
Band chains joining the sheet to V2.
Diagram: Band chain.

10Tape the seam

Put one strip of electrical tape across the full 88 mm width where the sheet leaves the V2 slot. Press it flat with no wrinkles.

11Tape the front edge

Put one strip across the front edge of the sheet, onto floor plate 375, so the edge stays down.
Diagram: Sheet, slot and tape, side view.

12Tape the tie tails

Wrap a small piece of tape over any cut zip tie tail near the ball path.
The finished assembly.
